question: In what form is the vital principle said to be situated within all beings?
premises: Air is described as filling with breath
This air is present in all beings
It is said to be situated there
inference: The vital air, filled with breath, is situated within all living beings.
uncertainties: Agreement of saṃsthitam with vāyuḥ is unusual but taken as describing the same principle.
plain_english: The breath-filled air is situated within all living beings.
